answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The ledge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tide is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The walnut of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit.
